title: How to Wash Synthetics Safely and Reduce Microfiber Shedding
description: Every time you wash synthetic clothing, microplastics enter the water supply. Here's how to reduce shedding without getting rid of clothes you already own.
lede: Every time you wash synthetic clothing, microplastics enter the water supply. Here's how to reduce shedding without getting rid of clothes you already own.
excerpt: Most people know synthetic fabrics shed microplastics — but not everyone knows that how you wash them can significantly affect how much they shed. Small changes…
